power

seamless

and
traditional

a
grid

manages
thousands
of
windmills
and
hundreds
of
thousands
of
customers
.
Computer
controlled
,
the
grid
is
able
to
manage

supply
and
demand
and
provides
a
real-time
power
balance

Far
more
complex
than
anything
in
existence
today

it

a
new

seen
